papers.title: ECB caught in the French drama (Carsten Brzeski)
papers.summary: ECB expected on hold on 29 Oct. The jump in bond yields after the French crisis already tightens policy: German yields ~ a 25bp hike, France ~ 50bp. Next hike decision pushed to December (new projections). Path depends on Middle East war length, energy pass-through, and French contagion. Defences: dovish rates, flexible reinvestment (pause QT), then TPI, which is hard to justify while France is non-compliant with fiscal rules.

papers.title: FX Daily: Dollar has lost its safe-haven crown
papers.summary: Equities sold off on oil and AI worries; JPY and CHF were the safe-haven winners, not USD. Bond/equity negative correlation is back. UST 10y below 5%, 2y SOFR swap -15bp to 4.50%, but the bar to price out a December Fed hike is high. OAT-Bund 10y at 174bp (peak 178bp); EUR sensitivity to France can return quickly. CEE hit by risk-off (PLN, HUF vulnerable; EUR/HUF capped 368-370). MXN -8% since early Sept; Banxico dovish; USD/MXN 19.00-19.10 trajectory.

papers.title: Rates Spark: US and France like ships passing in the night at 5%
papers.summary: UST 10y broke below 5% on risk-off; ING expects it to revert above 5% (inflation, deficits, AI boom, US midterms), timing uncertain. French 10y above 5%, spread ~175bp vs Germany. Moody's (Aa3 negative) downgrade looks overdue, no fixed release time. A lasting French relief needs a credible 2027 budget, possibly not before December. Weak PMIs could trigger a bullish rates repricing and a more dovish ECB.

papers.title: The Commodities Feed: Brent builds geopolitical premium as Gulf risks rise
papers.summary: Brent +4% to just above $113/bbl on fears of renewed US-Iran escalation (reported strike consideration, second carrier, troop evacuations). ING's 4Q26 $80 average now looks unattainable; re-escalation seen as most likely path. TTF above EUR90/MWh (highest since Dec 2022); LNG largely absent this winter. Gold -2.8% toward $4,000 on inflation/policy worries; copper down on rising inventories and AI-stock selloff.

stories.name: French fiscal crisis and the ECB
stories.summary: French yields above 5% and OAT-Bund spread at ~175bp are doing the ECB's tightening for it. ECB should hold on 29 Oct and hint dovishly; a Moody's downgrade is pending. The key question is whether this stays a French problem or spreads to the eurozone and forces ECB support (QT pause, then TPI).

scenarios.name: Contained, grinding stress
scenarios.description: Spreads stay 150-180bp, Moody's downgrade is absorbed, ECB holds in Oct and stays cautious in Dec. No TPI.
scenarios.fx_impact: EUR range-bound with a downside skew; the EUR/France correlation spikes on bad days.

scenarios.name: French relief
scenarios.description: Credible 2027 budget with real consolidation and calmer risk sentiment; spreads retrace.
scenarios.fx_impact: EUR supported; ECB hike pricing returns, positive for EURUSD.

scenarios.name: Contagion and ECB backstop
scenarios.description: Spreads blow out past 180bp, Italy/Spain widen, ECB pauses QT or reinvests flexibly, and TPI becomes live (possibly excluding France).
scenarios.fx_impact: EUR weaker; safe-haven bid for CHF/JPY; Bunds rally.

scenarios.name: Disorderly sovereign event
scenarios.description: Failed auctions or a multi-notch downgrade cascade force emergency policy action.

stories.name: Oil shock and US-Iran re-escalation
stories.summary: Brent at ~$113 carries a growing Gulf risk premium; ING now sees re-escalation as the likeliest path, which breaks its $80 4Q26 call. Energy prices drive ECB and Fed hike odds, European gas (TTF above EUR90) and inflation.

scenarios.name: Elevated premium, no major disruption
scenarios.description: Brent stays $100-120 on threats and military build-up, with flows still intact.
scenarios.fx_impact: CAD/NOK supported; JPY and EUR pressured by terms of trade.

scenarios.name: De-escalation
scenarios.description: Diplomacy or the midterm effect calms tensions; the premium unwinds and Brent heads toward $90.
scenarios.fx_impact: Oil FX fades; EUR and JPY relief; lower hike pricing.

scenarios.name: Re-escalation, flows threatened
scenarios.description: US strikes on Iran and disruption risk; Brent above $120, gas spikes further.
scenarios.fx_impact: USD mixed (haven demand weak); JPY/CHF and CAD/NOK strongest; EUR hit by energy.

scenarios.name: Major supply outage
scenarios.description: Actual loss of Gulf flows; Brent far above $130.
scenarios.fx_impact: Severe risk-off; CHF/JPY surge; EM FX sells off.

stories.name: US rates, Fed hike risk and AI-valuation wobble
stories.summary: UST 10y slipped under 5% as AI worries and risk-off reasserted bond/equity inverse correlation. USD lost safe-haven status (JPY/CHF won). ING expects 10y to revert above 5%, and a December Fed hike is still not priced out. Gold falls on inflation/policy fears.

scenarios.name: Choppy around 5%, Dec hike alive
scenarios.description: 10y oscillates around 5%, USD consolidates if risk calms; JPY/CHF keep a haven bid on sell-offs.
scenarios.fx_impact: USD range-trade; USDJPY and USDCHF downside on risk-off days.

scenarios.name: Yields back above 5%, hawkish Fed
scenarios.description: Inflation, deficits and oil push yields up; December hike priced in; USD rebounds.
scenarios.fx_impact: USD up broadly; USDJPY higher; gold under pressure.

scenarios.name: AI-led risk-off and growth scare
scenarios.description: Equity sell-off deepens and data weaken; hike pricing collapses; yields fall sharply.
scenarios.fx_impact: JPY and CHF rally; USD weaker; EM FX sells off.

scenarios.name: Disorderly bond/equity break
scenarios.description: Disorderly Treasury/equity move forces central bank response.

stories.name: EM and CEE FX under pressure
stories.summary: MXN is worst EM performer (-8% since early Sept) on dovish Banxico and US-rate shock; RON next (-4%). PLN and HUF are vulnerable to energy-import costs and non-hawkish central banks; EUR/HUF capped at 368-370.

scenarios.name: Persistent weakness
scenarios.description: Banxico stays dovish on 5 Nov; USD/MXN 19.00-19.10; PLN/HUF drift weaker with energy.
scenarios.fx_impact: USDMXN up, EURPLN up, EURHUF capped.

scenarios.name: Relief rally
scenarios.description: Banxico hawkish surprise or oil/risk calm.

scenarios.name: Deeper sell-off
scenarios.description: Global risk-off and AI unrest, with Mexico's US-securities exposure adding outflows.
